name: subdomain-not-listed-defers
description: Manifest lists `amazon.com`. A subdomain like `smile.amazon.com` is a different host. canonicalize() does not strip arbitrary subdomains — only a leading 'www.'.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — canonical host is the URL's hostname after lowercasing and stripping a leading 'www.', no subdomain reduction.

name: case-insensitive-host-match
description: Hostname matching is case-insensitive across the canonicalisation step.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — lowercasing applies before equality check.

name: param-name-case-sensitive
description: Parameter NAMES are case-sensitive. `Tag=creator-21` (capital T) does NOT match the manifest's `tag` entry. The validator defers.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — paramName is matched literally against manifest entries; only the host is canonicalised.

name: owner-tag-without-conflict-no-strip
description: If only the implementer's own tag is present and ownerTag is set, the validator preserves it without producing a 'strip' decision.
citation: Sanity check on the creator-first conflict-resolution branching.

name: two-distinct-programs-amazon-and-vercel-not-applicable
description: A URL on amazon.com containing a `ref=` parameter does NOT match the Vercel program (which is keyed on vercel.com). Only `tag` matches, only one program is identified.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — `(host, paramName)` matching is per-program.

name: humble-bundle-partner-deprecated-defer
description: Humble Bundle's `partner` direct-injection entry was soft-deprecated 2026-05-05 after the program migrated to Impact. Even at Strict level, deprecated entries MUST NOT match per SPEC §3.2 step 1 + §5.1.1.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 + §5.1.1 — deprecated entries are inert at all conformance levels. Incident #35.

name: digitalocean-refcode-preserve
description: DigitalOcean uses `refcode=` rather than `ref=`. Distinct from Vercel's `ref=` even though both are SaaS programs.
citation: https://www.digitalocean.com/referral-program — refcode is the program parameter name.

name: hash-fragment-ignored
description: URL hash fragments are ignored by the validator — the algorithm operates on host + query string only.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — matching is on hostname; pathname and fragment are not consulted for direct-injection programs. The fragment is delivered to the destination as-is by the implementer.

name: trailing-slash-and-query-do-not-affect-match
description: Trailing path slash and additional query params do not affect host-based program matching.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — matching is on hostname; pathname is not consulted for direct-injection programs.

name: owner-tag-conflict-with-three-third-party
description: ownerTag plus three different third-party values: preserve the first third-party by position, strip the implementer's own AND the surplus third-party duplicates.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 2 — third-party preferred over owner; among multiple third-party values, preserve a single instance.
